note: SECONDARY predicate, and emphatically NOT a crash test -- see match.json for that. This one asks only 'did this build refuse to compile the repro at all', because #4032 (2021-10) claimed the compiler 'emits error message and rejects input' for this construct, which contradicts the two release endpoints bisect probed (both exit 0 with correct NumThreads=(8,8,1) metadata). bisect short-circuits when endpoints agree, so a mid-range window in which releases rejected the input would be invisible; this predicate plus --linear is what rules that out. On Windows dxc returns E_FAIL (0x80004005) for ordinary diagnosed errors and 0xE0000001 for an assert, so a nonzero exit here means 'did not produce DXIL', nothing more. It deliberately scores the Debug ground truth as a match, because the assert is also a failure to compile. CONTROL: control-literal.hlsl scored under this predicate must be no-match; see variant-literal-rejected-main-debug.txt.
